name: print-social-lavender-lime-walking-club-instagram-trio
title: Walking Club Instagram Trio
whatItIs: Three Instagram post frames on black: a crumpled lavender poster over a street photo, a lime post with a smiling flower doodle asking 'Why people join walk clubs', and a photo post with lime headline 'Walking Social Club' and event details.
whatItMeans: Loud lavender and lime with heavy black type and smiley doodles feel sociable and youthful.
techniques: Crumpled paper texture on the lavender poster
Doodled daisy characters as brand elements
Heavy extended black headlines on flat colour
Lime type over a darkened photo

vocabulary.definition: A simple hand-drawn character used as a brand accent.
A wrinkled poster effect applied to a flat layout.
Three posts designed to sit side by side in a feed.
